sources.entry: PixelFed - Ethical photo sharing platform, powered by ActivityPub federation (alternative to Instagram). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Pixelfed is an ActivityPub-federated photo sharing platform, a self-hostable alternative to Instagram that avoids algorithmic feeds.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Pixelfed as a photo sharing platform where casual shots and creative photography are meant to find an audience without algorithmic barriers. It federates with the wider fediverse through ActivityPub. The README points to external documentation sites for setup and for API and developer references. It recommends running instances with Docker Compose, while stating that non-Docker installs are also supported. It lists supported PHP versions (8.5 recommended, 8.4 supported) and database options (MySQL 8+, MariaDB 11+, and PostgreSQL 14+ on a best-effort basis). The README also includes a policy rejecting contributions substantially generated by AI or large language models.
use_cases: federated photo sharing with fediverse users
run a community photo instance via Docker
how_to_run: As of September 2026, the README recommends running instances with Docker Compose
Non-Docker installation is supported per the README; see the Pixelfed documentation website
Database: MySQL 8+ or MariaDB 11+ officially supported; PostgreSQL 14+ best effort
Setup details are on the Pixelfed documentation website (link not included in README text)
notable: Federates via ActivityPub with the fediverse
No algorithmic feed barriers, per the README's positioning
Official Docker and non-Docker deployment paths
Published API and developer documentation site
caveats: PostgreSQL support is best effort and the README says it is not recommended
Older unsupported PHP versions may work but are not recommended; PHP 8.4 support ends 31 Dec 2026
The README says database-agnostic testing needs considerable engineering effort, so regressions may occur outside MySQL/MariaDB
